download_parallel_files: download multiple files in parallel from a list of URLs to an output folder
extract_zip_archives: extract all zip archives from a directory in parallel to an output directory
extract_tar_archives: extract all tar archives from a directory in parallel to an output directory
download_gdown: download a file from Google Drive using gdown with fuzzy link parsing
download_wget: download a file from a URL using wget with optional SSL certificate skipping
